video_title: Pascal Siakam, Tyrese Haliburton & Lloyd Pierce Media Availability | October 16, 2026

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on building chemistry and getting into game shape
quotes.excerpt: Obviously, Tyrese Haliburton is a big part of what we do, just trying to figure out a way
quotes.quote: Obviously, Tyrese Haliburton is a big part of what we do, just trying to figure out a way to have him get back on the floor, figure out Zu. For me, preseason is just getting in shape, trying to figure out my teammates' tendencies. I put a lot of work into my game, I'm never worried about anything. I just go out there and play the game. I know that when you play the game the right way, you always get rewarded.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam says he is focused on getting into game shape and learning his teammates tendencies during the preseason. He says he is never worried about his own game because he knows that if you play the right way you always get rewarded.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on developing chemistry with Ivica Zubac
quotes.excerpt: Him being a great passer, me continuing to learn how to cut, I feel like we will get easy stuff
quotes.quote: Understanding his positioning, where he's going to be. We had a couple of talks where him playing two-man game with me, I feel like him being a great passer, me continuing to learn how to cut, I feel like we will get easy stuff together. And obviously, continue to extend my range, it's only going to get us better. He's smart, he's high IQ, and his rebounding also helps us.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam is working on his two man game with Ivica Zubac. Siakam says he is learning how to cut better to complement Zubac as a passer and plans to continue extending his shooting range to help the team.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his appreciation for the Indiana fan base
quotes.excerpt: I don't take basketball for granted. I don't take the opportunity to be healthy for granted.
quotes.quote: It's special, man. I don't take basketball for granted. I don't take the opportunity to be healthy and be back on the floor doing what I love for granted. This state, this fan base means a lot to me, so it's very much so appreciated and ready to get to the real games.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says he does not take being healthy for granted as he prepares for the upcoming season. He expressed his appreciation for the Indiana fan base and says he is ready to get to the real games.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the team's offensive potential and defensive needs
quotes.excerpt: I think offensively we are who we are, we're going to be one of the best offensive teams
quotes.quote: I think the more time that goes on, the more we're unlocking each other offensively, figuring out where guys want to be. I thought Drew Timme was great tonight, I thought Kelly Olynyk was great tonight. I think offensively we are who we are, we're going to be one of the best offensive teams in the league with our personnel. We just got to be better defensively.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton is confident in the Pacers offensive ceiling but knows the team needs to improve on the other end. He says we are going to be one of the best offensive teams in the league with our personnel but we just got to be better defensively.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on Ivica Zubac's impact on team rebounding
quotes.excerpt: Zu is the best rebounder we've ever played with and does a lot of great things there
quotes.quote: Zu is the best rebounder we've ever played with and does a lot of great things there, but we got to hold our own, especially us guards. We got to do a better job boxing out, allowing him to get those rebounds then we can run.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says Ivica Zubac is the best rebounder he has ever played with but wants the guards to do a better job boxing out to help the team get out and run.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on Ivica Zubac's screening ability
quotes.excerpt: He hits people, man. I feel like I can slow down even more because I know he's going to make contact
quotes.quote: He hits people, man. I feel like I can slow down even more because I know he's going to make contact all the time. He enjoys hitting people, and so it's been a lot of fun. We're growing a lot in our relationship as well, just being able to communicate.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says he can play at a slower pace because of Ivica Zubac. He says he knows Zubac is going to make contact all the time because he enjoys hitting people which makes the pick and roll game a lot of fun.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the growth of Braden Smith
quotes.excerpt: He kind of has a knack like T.J. McConnell of being able to get to the baseline easily
quotes.quote: He's growing every day, just learning who he is as a player. He kind of has a knack like T.J. McConnell of being able to get to the baseline easily. He's an unbelievable passer, that's a very underrated skill of his. He can find anybody and make passes with either hand, but he's got to continue to be aggressive.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton is impressed by the growth of Braden Smith. He compared Smith to T.J. McConnell noting his ability to get to the baseline and his underrated passing skill with either hand.

quotes.speaker: Lloyd Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Lloyd Pierce on the chemistry between the team's core players
quotes.excerpt: Those four guys, Drew, Ty, Pascal and Aaron have had chemistry for a couple years
quotes.quote: There is a level of patience that all of them have shown. Pascal really had a great showing in the first half today. Ty is always going to be the guy that sets the table for everyone. And I think he and Zu have a great rapport already in the pick-and-roll. Those four guys, Drew, Ty, Pascal and Aaron have had chemistry for a couple years and Zu has jumped into this seamlessly thus far.
quotes.social_post: Lloyd Pierce says Ivica Zubac has integrated seamlessly into the Pacers core. He noted that the chemistry between Tyrese Haliburton and Zubac in the pick and roll is already looking great.

quotes.speaker: Lloyd Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Lloyd Pierce on how Ivica Zubac's absence changes team spacing
quotes.excerpt: Of the fives he's right now the non-shooting five, and so we get different spacing
quotes.quote: Of the fives he's right now the non-shooting five, and so we get different spacing when he's off the floor. There's some different challenges that come with that as well. We have positional size and we have versatility when we start to sub, and I think that's going to be something that probably will be to our benefit at times.
quotes.social_post: Lloyd Pierce explains how the team adjusts when Ivica Zubac is off the floor. He says the team faces different spacing challenges without their primary non shooting five but believes their positional size and versatility will be a benefit.
